Today, the Senate confirmed an outstanding U.S. District Judge and Alabama-native, Kasdin Miller Mitchell. 

While her resume speaks for itself, I’ve experienced Kasdin’s integrity, class, grit, and intellect firsthand for over twenty years. I’ve always believed that Kasdin would serve our nation in some capacity—her passion for serving those around her is evident in all that she does.

posts.text:
Great to visit with University of West Alabama President Todd Fritch and UWA leadership today!

Congratulations to the UWA Tigers on being named Washington Monthly’s Best College for Rural America! It was wonderful to hear about their work to expand opportunities for students and strengthen communities across West Alabama.
posts.summary: Supports university expansion of rural student opportunities

Always great to visit with the Cullman Chamber of Commerce!

We had a productive conversation about Cullman County’s priorities and the work ahead to support continued economic growth, strengthen local infrastructure, and create even more opportunities for families and businesses across the community.

I’ve fought for this project since my first days in the Senate, because this corridor is a lifeline for our state, connecting the Port of Mobile, our shipbuilders, our military assets, hardworking Alabamians, and Americans who travel to our great state. 

I’m grateful to @POTUS, @SecDuffy, and @SusieWiles for their tireless support, cutting through the red tape, and delivering for Alabama.
